name: mcp-fastmcp-structured-output
description: Build or migrate a Python MCP server on the 2.x SDK (mcp.server.mcpserver.MCPServer) with signature-derived, enforced input schemas, TypedDict output schemas, titles/annotations, an in-process mcp.client.Client for tests, and a docs-drift + structural eval gate. Trigger when: (1) migrating kintsugi.mcp or any FastMCP/low-level mcp.server.Server to mcp 2.x, (2) 'mcp.server.fastmcp' ImportError or an mcp<2 pin, (3) adding structured output / outputSchema to MCP tools, (4) an MCP tool result fails output validation with 'None is not of type ...', (5) building an MCP tool-selection evaluation harness or wiring it into CI.
